objective: 验证长事务导致死元组积压后对查询计划生成性能的影响，模拟故障链路：长事务持有旧快照 → autovacuum无法回收死元组 → 表膨胀导致优化器代价估算偏差 → SQL整体变慢

prechecks: confirm drill schema fault_drill exists or can be created
confirm autovacuum is enabled on target table
confirm current dead tuple count baseline
confirm current EXPLAIN cost baseline for test query
confirm no existing long transactions on target DB
during_checks: run EXPLAIN on test query every 60s and record cost
monitor autovacuum state (should be blocked by long tx)
monitor xid age and snapshot oldest xmin
success_conditions: EXPLAIN cost increases by > 50% from baseline
autovacuum is visibly blocked during injection

rollback.trigger: trap EXIT INT TERM HUP — 脚本退出即清理，无需超时计时器
steps: terminate the long-holding session via pg_terminate_backend
confirm dead tuple count drops to near zero
confirm EXPLAIN cost returns to baseline range
success_conditions: no long transactions remain on target DB
sql p95 latency returns to baseline
